slots.label: Paragraph 1
slots.default: Not covered here? Ask us directly — same working day response.

slots.label: Question 1
slots.default: Isn’t a firewall enough to secure our network?

slots.label: Paragraph 2
slots.default: A firewall is essential, but it’s only the perimeter. Real security also depends on how internal access is controlled, how remote workers connect, whether devices and firmware are up to date, and how much visibility you have into traffic. We look across all of these, not just the firewall.

slots.label: Question 2
slots.default: What is network segmentation and why does it matter?

slots.label: Paragraph 3
slots.default: Segmentation separates your network into zones so systems can only reach what they genuinely need. It matters because it limits how far an intruder, or a piece of malware, can move if one device is compromised, containing a problem rather than letting it spread across the business.

slots.label: Question 3
slots.default: Can you secure remote and hybrid working?

slots.label: Paragraph 4
slots.default: Yes. We provide encrypted remote access with stronger authentication so your team can work securely from anywhere, without the connection becoming a weak point. It’s designed to protect the business while staying easy for staff to use.

slots.label: Question 4
slots.default: How often should firewall rules be reviewed?

slots.label: Paragraph 5
slots.default: At least annually, and after any significant change such as a new site, cloud service or major project. Rules tend to accumulate over time, so regular reviews stop old, unnecessary access quietly widening your exposure.

slots.label: Question 5
slots.default: Will a review disrupt our network?

slots.label: Paragraph 6
slots.default: No. Assessment work is carried out carefully and any changes are planned and agreed with you in advance, scheduled around your operations so your team and customers aren’t affected.
